story.titleZh: 法拉利对汉密尔顿与勒克莱尔问题的解决方案保密
story.summaryZh: 勒克莱尔与汉密尔顿在卡塔尔讨论了拉斯维加斯大奖赛的碰撞事件，但法拉利不会透露解决车手问题的方案细节。勒克莱尔因碰撞被罚10秒，车队领队瓦塞尔称该碰撞“不可接受”。
story.originalTitle: Why Ferrari's coy on 'solution' to Hamilton-Leclerc problem
story.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton discussed their Las Vegas Grand Prix clash in Qatar, but Ferrari will not reveal details of any solution to its ongoing driver problem. Leclerc was penalised 10 seconds for the collision, which team principal Fred Vasseur called "unacceptable".
detailZh: 查尔斯·勒克莱尔和刘易斯·汉密尔顿已在卡塔尔讨论了他们在拉斯维加斯大奖赛上的碰撞，但法拉利一级方程式车队不会透露解决其持续存在的车手问题的任何“方案”细节。
勒克莱尔因在上周末比赛中与汉密尔顿的碰撞被罚10秒，车队领队弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔称该碰撞“不可接受”。
鉴于勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿今年早些时候已发生一系列有争议的冲突，例如在蒙扎和墨西哥，两位车手都面临了媒体关于此次碰撞以及可能发生什么变化的大量提问。
“我们两个人，每人一辆车，我们需要确保事情能够顺利进行。目前，它行不通，”勒克莱尔承认道。
"当然，我可以把某一次事件的责任揽下来，那都无所谓。
"重要的是我们找到一个双方都能接受的折中方案。我们可以讨论拉斯维加斯或其他地方的具体情况，或者之前或之后的圈数，但那并不重要。
"归根结底，在那一刻，只有解决方案才是重要的。"
当被 The Race 问及他是否有关于解决方案的想法时，勒克莱尔回答说："是的，我有，而且我认为我已经表达得很清楚了，但我更愿意在内部进行这些讨论。
“我确实有看法，但最终重要的是我们集体认为什么是正确的决定，这将在内部进行。”
瓦塞尔与两位车手都谈了，勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿周四在卡塔尔媒体会前讨论了该事件，汉密尔顿称会谈“积极”。
但他不愿透露细节。
“一切留在内部，”汉密尔顿说，呼应了勒克莱尔在被问及最后两站是否会实施新比赛规则时“我不能透露”的回答。
法拉利不愿披露任何潜在的比赛规则变更，很可能是因为如果本周末这些规则未被严格遵守，就会招致批评。
汉密尔顿最初在九月初的蒙扎比赛期间呼吁在车手之间引入比赛规则，但他表示这些规则的实施“最终由弗雷德决定”。
“我当时已经把我的观点说清楚了。关于这件事真的没什么更多可说的了。我之前已经表明了我的立场，我的观点并没有真正改变。”
勒克莱尔不愿被拉回重提拉斯维加斯事件的细节，因为当有人向他指出他的赛车与汉密尔顿并排但未被留出空间时，他说：“我真的不想再回到那次冲突上。”
“我只想向前看。我理解你的观点，也认为它很有道理。但与此同时，我不想再回到那次冲突上。”
汉密尔顿表示，在与勒克莱尔缠斗时，他始终把车队放在心上。
当被问及通过沟通能提前规避多少问题时，他说：“你永远无法覆盖所有情况，因为每个场景都不同。但你可以逐弯复盘每一场比赛并讨论各种情况，查尔斯和我已经这么做了。
“总会出现一些你可能没有预见到的新情况。但你也必须依靠直觉，而且归根结底，你始终要把车队放在心上。”
“仅就我个人而言，当我在驾驶时，当我在赛道上攻击任何人时，我总是会想‘好吧，这会如何影响我身后的每一个人？’从车队角度考虑。所以我确实努力尽可能负责任，并在进攻时做出最好的决定，我想。”
当勒克莱尔被问及瓦塞尔的“不可接受”言论时，他回答说：“我的意思是，这当然不可接受。作为一支车队，我们承受不起队友之间的冲突。
“这对每个人来说都非常清楚。特别是拉斯维加斯的那次冲突，正如我所说，我承担了责任。我认为只是存在一些紧张情绪，我们只需要消散它，并确保我们着眼于未来更积极的日子。
“这就是我所寻求的全部。但我确实同意。法拉利两次冲突加在一起，当然是不可接受的。”
汉密尔顿确信他和勒克莱尔会解决这个问题。
“我们会弄清楚的，你知道吗？我们归根结底是队友。而且我认为我们总能学到东西，”汉密尔顿说。
“我们会从这段艰难时期中汲取经验教训。我仍然相信我们在幕后所做的一切建设和努力。我来这里的目标是带领法拉利重返巅峰。这是一个极具挑战性的赛季。人们很容易看到消极的一面，但我更愿意看到今年的积极面：我们正在争夺车队锦标赛的第二名；我们赢得过比赛；我认为今年我们拥有最好的赛车，尤其是在底盘方面。
“所以，我只是努力去看积极的一面，而不是……我觉得大家似乎总是关注消极的东西，这显然是生活中最容易做的事。但我努力记住积极的一面，今年我们确实一起做出了了不起的、一些惊人的事情。”
勒克莱尔也非常希望平息拉斯维加斯站后出现的猜测，即他的合同中存在某种“一号”优先待遇条款。
“我通常从不透露合同内容，但我觉得这一条值得说明，”勒克莱尔说。
“我的合同里绝对没有任何这样的条款。这从来不是我感兴趣的东西，也从来不是我个人想要的。所以没有，我没有。”
“归根结底，这是我们工作的一部分。我认为我唯一不喜欢看到的是人们质疑我对车队的诚信、我对车队的热爱。我从2019年就在法拉利了。我认为我对车队的热爱再清楚不过了。
“为了把法拉利带回巅峰，我会竭尽全力。当然，过程中难免会犯错，而且永远都会。我们只是尽量把错误降到最低，尤其是在队友之间。”
“但我觉得，更让我受伤的是我看到四处流传的那个问号本身。”
“其余的都只是很多噪音，现在并不是最愉快的时期，但这是比赛的一部分，我必须接受。”
detailEn: Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton have discussed their Las Vegas Grand Prix clash in Qatar, but the Ferrari Formula 1 team will not reveal details of any "solution" to its ongoing driver problem.
Leclerc was penalised 10 seconds for what team principal Fred Vasseur labelled an "unacceptable" collision between the two drivers during last weekend's race.

Both drivers faced a barrage of questions from the media about the clash and what might change, given Leclerc and Hamilton have had a series of controversial run-ins earlier in the year, such as at Monza and in Mexico.
"We are two, one in each car, and we need to make sure that things just work out. At the moment, it's not working," Leclerc admitted.
"Then, of course, I can take the blame from one episode and whatever. That doesn't really matter.

"It's just important that we find a compromise and a solution that works for both. We can discuss about the specific of Las Vegas or somewhere else, or the laps before or laps after, but that doesn't really matter.
"At the end of the day, it's only the solution that matters in that moment."
Asked by The Race if he had ideas of what the solution could be, Leclerc replied: "Yeah, I do have and I think I've made it very clear, but I would rather have these discussions internally.
"I do have an opinion, but at the end, what matters is what we think is the right decision collectively, and this will take it internally."
Vasseur spoke to both drivers and Leclerc and Hamilton discussed the incident in Qatar on Thursday prior to their media sessions, with Hamilton describing the talks as "positive".
But he was unwilling to disclose the details.
"Everything stays internal," said Hamilton, echoing Leclerc's "I cannot disclose that" answers when asked if there would be new racing rules implemented for the final two rounds.
Ferrari's unwillingness to disclose any potential racing rule changes is likely because it would open it up to criticism if those rules are not strictly followed this weekend.
Hamilton first called for the introduction of racing rules between the drivers at the Monza race in early September, but he said the implementation of them is "for Fred to decide [on] ultimately".
"I made my point clear already back then. There's not really much more to say on it, really. I said my piece before and my point hasn't really changed."

Leclerc did not want to be drawn into revisiting the specifics of the Las Vegas incident as, when it was put to him that he had his car alongside Hamilton's but was not left room, he said: "I don't really want to go back to that clash.
"I just want to look forward. I understand your point and I think it's a valid one. But at the same time, I don't want to go back to that clash."
Hamilton said he has the team in mind when he has been battling Leclerc.

Asked about how much could be preempted with conversations, he said: "You can never cover everything because every scenario is different. But you can go through every single race corner-by-corner and discuss things, which Charles and I have.
"There's always going to be something new that you maybe haven't foreseen. But also you have to use your instinct and you also always, at the core of it, have to have the team [in mind].

"Just speaking for myself, when I'm driving, when I'm attacking whoever it is on track, I'm always thinking 'OK, how is this going to impact everybody behind me?' team-wise. So I really do try to be as responsible as I can and make the best decision when I am attacking, I think."
When Leclerc was asked about Vasseur's "unacceptable" comments, he replied: "I mean that it is unacceptable, of course. As a team, we cannot afford to clash between team-mates.

"That is very clear for everyone. For the clash in particular in Las Vegas, as I said, I took responsibility. I think there's just tension around that we just need to dissipate and make sure that we look at more positive days in the future.
"That's all I'm looking for. But I do agree. It's unacceptable that both Ferrari clashes together, of course."
Hamilton was convinced he and Leclerc would resolve the matter.
"We're going to figure it out, you know? We're team-mates at the end of the day. And I think we always learn," Hamilton said.

"There will be learnings that we take from this difficult period. And I still believe in everything we're building and working towards in the background. I came here with the goal of taking Ferrari back to the top. And it's been a massively challenging season. It's so easy to look at the negatives, but I like to look at the positives this year: we're fighting for second in the constructors' championship; we have had wins; I think we've had the best car, chassis-wise particularly, this year.

“So, I'm just trying to look at the positives and just not...I think everyone seems to be focusing always on the negatives, which is obviously the easiest thing to do in life. But I try to remember the positives and we've really done amazing, some amazing things this year together."
Leclerc was also very keen to squash speculation that emerged after Vegas that he has any kind of '#1' preferential treatment clause in his contract.
"I normally never disclose what I have in my contract, but I think this one is an important one to speak about," Leclerc said.
"And I absolutely have zero clause that says that in my contract. It's never something that I was interested in and never something that I personally wanted. So no, I don't.

"At the end of the day, it's part of our job. I think the only thing that I don't like seeing is people questioning my integrity to the team, my love for the team. I've been in Ferrari since 2019. I think there's nothing clearer than the love I have for the team.

"I'll do absolutely everything in order to bring Ferrari back to the top. Then, of course, mistakes happen along the way and always will. We just try to have to minimise them and particularly between team-mates.
"But I think it's more the question mark of that that I have seen going around that hurts me more than anything else.
"The rest is a lot of noise and it's not the most enjoyable time, but it's part of the game and I have to accept that."
keyPointsZh: 勒克莱尔承认目前两人的配合“行不通”，并强调需要找到对双方都有效的妥协方案。
勒克莱尔表示自己已有想法，但更倾向于在内部讨论，最终以集体决定为准。
keyPointsEn: Leclerc admitted that things are "not working" between the two drivers and stressed the need to find a compromise that works for both.
Leclerc said he has ideas but would rather discuss them internally, with the collective decision being what matters.

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.
keyPointsZh: 倍耐力在击败普利司通的竞争性报价后赢得2025至2027年的F1轮胎供应合同，今年6月国际汽联行使选择权将合同延长一个赛季。
国际汽联将从2029年起启动新的招标程序，届时预计将出现新的竞争以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
